styles.name: Flash animation
styles.description: Looping Flash cartoons and songs from the pre-YouTube web.

styles.name: Viral video
styles.description: A single clip that everyone shared, quoted and remixed.

styles.name: Image macro
styles.description: A picture with bold caption text, usually Impact font.

styles.name: Reaction image
styles.description: A face or scene used to reply to something else.

styles.name: Template
styles.description: An exploitable image whose parts get relabelled for any situation.

styles.name: Comic
styles.description: Panels and stock faces, from rage comics to webcomic panels.

styles.name: Bait and switch
styles.description: A link or setup that turns out to be something else.

styles.name: Challenge
styles.description: Film yourself doing the thing, then tag someone.

styles.name: Song or remix
styles.description: A track, dance or audio clip that spread on its own.

styles.name: Catchphrase
styles.description: A phrase that escaped its source and became slang.

styles.name: Character
styles.description: A recurring animal, mascot or figure reused everywhere.

events.title: The year 2000 arrives
events.summary: The Y2K bug passes with far less trouble than feared.

events.title: Wikipedia launches
events.summary: The free encyclopedia anyone can edit goes online.

events.title: September 11 attacks
events.summary: Terrorist attacks in the United States kill nearly 3,000 people.

events.title: 4chan launches
events.summary: The anonymous imageboard that seeded a decade of memes.

events.title: Facebook launches
events.summary: Starts at Harvard, opens to everyone in 2006.

events.title: YouTube launches
events.summary: Video sharing goes mainstream; viral video memes follow.

events.title: Reddit launches
events.summary: The link-sharing site that becomes a meme clearing house.

events.title: Twitter launches
events.summary: Short public posts make catchphrases spread in hours.

events.title: iPhone announced
events.summary: Smartphones put a camera and the internet in every pocket.

events.title: Lehman Brothers collapses
events.summary: The peak of the global financial crisis.

events.title: Instagram launches
events.summary: Photo sharing built around the phone camera.

events.title: Vine launches
events.summary: Six-second looping videos; shut down in January 2017.

events.title: Harambe shot at Cincinnati Zoo
events.summary: A gorilla is shot after a child climbs into his enclosure.

events.title: Brexit referendum
events.summary: The UK votes to leave the European Union.

events.title: Trump elected US president
events.summary: Donald Trump wins the 2016 US presidential election.

events.title: Musical.ly merges into TikTok
events.summary: TikTok goes global and short video takes over meme culture.

events.title: COVID-19 declared a pandemic
events.summary: The WHO declares a pandemic; much of the world locks down.

events.title: Biden inaugurated
events.summary: Joe Biden is sworn in as US president.

events.title: Ever Given blocks the Suez Canal
events.summary: A container ship wedges sideways in the canal for six days.

events.title: ChatGPT released
events.summary: AI chatbots go mainstream, and so do AI-generated images.

events.title: Barbie and Oppenheimer open
events.summary: Two very different films release on the same day.

memes.name: All your base are belong to us
memes.summary: A badly translated line from the 1991 game Zero Wing, set to a techno song in a Flash video.

memes.name: Star Wars Kid
memes.summary: A teenager swinging a golf ball retriever like a lightsaber, leaked online without his consent.

memes.name: Badger Badger Badger
memes.summary: Weebl's looping Flash animation of badgers, a mushroom and a snake.

memes.name: Numa Numa
memes.summary: Gary Brolsma lip-syncing to O-Zone's "Dragostea din tei" at his webcam.

memes.name: Leeroy Jenkins
memes.summary: A player charges into a carefully planned raid shouting his own name.

memes.name: LOLcats
memes.summary: Cat photos captioned in broken "lolspeak"; the Cheezburger site launched in 2007.

events.note: Saturday cat posts on 4chan came first.

memes.name: Rickroll
memes.summary: A promised link turns out to be Rick Astley's "Never Gonna Give You Up".

memes.name: Charlie bit my finger
memes.summary: A baby bites his older brother's finger. Once YouTube's most-viewed video.

memes.name: Dramatic Chipmunk
memes.summary: Five seconds of a prairie dog turning to camera, with a dramatic sting.

memes.name: Trollface
memes.summary: Carlos Ramirez's grinning MS Paint face, the mascot of internet trolling.

memes.name: Rage comics
memes.summary: Crude four-panel comics built from stock faces like Forever Alone and Y U NO.

memes.name: Keyboard Cat
memes.summary: An old clip of a cat "playing" keyboard, used to play people off after a fail.

memes.name: Nyan Cat
memes.summary: A Pop-Tart cat flying through space trailing a rainbow, to a looping J-pop song.

memes.name: Grumpy Cat
memes.summary: Tardar Sauce, a cat whose face looked permanently unimpressed.

memes.name: Gangnam Style
memes.summary: Psy's horse-riding dance; the first YouTube video to pass a billion views.

memes.name: Harlem Shake
memes.summary: Thirty seconds: one person dances alone, then the bass drops and everyone does.

memes.name: Doge
memes.summary: A Shiba Inu ringed by Comic Sans: "such wow, very meme". The photo is from 2010.

memes.name: This is fine
memes.summary: KC Green's dog sipping coffee in a burning room. Took off as a reaction image around 2016.

memes.name: Ice Bucket Challenge
memes.summary: Pour ice water over your head, donate to ALS research, nominate three friends.

memes.name: Harambe
memes.summary: Mock-earnest tributes to the gorilla, which went on for the rest of the year.

events.note: The meme began within days of the shooting.

memes.name: Damn Daniel
memes.summary: A teen compliments his friend's white Vans, one day at a time.

memes.name: Mannequin Challenge
memes.summary: Groups freeze mid-action while a camera moves through the scene, usually to "Black Beatles".

memes.name: Salt Bae
memes.summary: Chef Nusret Gökçe sprinkling salt off his forearm.

memes.name: Distracted Boyfriend
memes.summary: A man turns to look at another woman while his girlfriend glares. The stock photo is from 2015.

memes.name: Storm Area 51
memes.summary: A joke Facebook event to raid Area 51: "they can't stop all of us".

memes.name: Woman Yelling at a Cat
memes.summary: A Real Housewives screenshot paired with a confused cat at a dinner table.

memes.name: OK Boomer
memes.summary: A two-word dismissal of older generations' advice.

memes.name: Coffin Dance
memes.summary: Ghanaian pallbearers dancing with a coffin, cut onto fail videos to "Astronomia".

events.note: Took off as dark humour during the first lockdowns.

memes.name: Bernie's mittens
memes.summary: Bernie Sanders sitting cross-legged in mittens, photoshopped into everything.

events.note: The photo was taken at the inauguration.

memes.name: Ever Given
memes.summary: One tiny excavator against a giant stuck ship, as a picture of any overwhelming task.

memes.name: Skibidi Toilet
memes.summary: Animated singing heads in toilets at war with camera-headed men.

memes.name: Barbenheimer
memes.summary: Mashups of pink Barbie and grim Oppenheimer before their shared opening day.

memes.name: Hawk Tuah
memes.summary: A street interview answer that became a catchphrase overnight.

memes.name: Moo Deng
memes.summary: A baby pygmy hippo at a Thai zoo, famous for being bouncy and bitey.
